events.title: Seek Shellter in Next Fest October 2026
events.summary: We are very excited to participate in October's Next Fest, the final one for 2026! Thank you to everyone who played the demo at AVCon 2026, your feedback has helped immensely. The latest demo version has addressed many of the thoughtful tips and notes suggested, and we are very keen for new players to experience the first part of the game. Thank you again for your support, and we look forward to a full release in December! Please leave a review and let us know what you think.

events.title: Seek Shellter at AVCon 2026 + Demo Release
events.summary: Hello everyone! We are excited for our first showcase of Seek Shellter at AVCon in Adelaide this weekend and we look forward to seeing you there if you are going! If you can't make it, we have also just now released the demo on Steam so you can still check out the game! Thank you for showing your support for Seek Shellter and we hope you will share your demo experience with us and your friends.
